Existing Loanee farmers who do not want to get covered under the scheme have the option of opting -out...

applies_to: Notified crops per state/season notification

rule_text: 5.1 Basic Cover: The basic cover under t he scheme covers the risk of loss of yield to standing crop (sowing to harvesting).This c omprehensive risk insurance is provided to cover yield losses on an area based approach basis due to non-preventable risks like drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, wide spread pest and disease attack, landslides, natural...
applies_to: Standing crops from sowing to harvesting (area approach)
deadline_or_rate: Non-preventable natural perils

rule_text: 5.2.1 Prevented Sowing /Planting/Germination Risk : Insured area is prevented from sowing/ planting/germination due to deficit rainfall or adverse seasonal/climatic conditions. 21.3.2.7 The amount payable would be 25% of the gross total Sum Insured and the insurance coverage shall get terminated. Farmers can have the alternative to sow shorter...
applies_to: Notified area (>75% prevented from sowing)
deadline_or_rate: 25% of Sum Insured; cover terminates

rule_text: 5.2.2 Mid-Season Adversity: Loss in case of adverse seasonal conditions during the crop season viz. floods, prolonged dry s pells and severe drought etc., wherein expected yield during the... 21.4.2.7 Amount payable would be 25% of the likely claims, subject to adjustment against final claims based on yield assessment data arrived through...
applies_to: Notified unit when expected yield < 50% of normal
deadline_or_rate: 25% of likely claims (on-account within 30 days)

rule_text: 5.2.3 Post-Harvest Losses: Coverage is available only up to a maximum period of two weeks from harvesting, for those crops which are required to be dried in cut and spread / small bundled condition depending on requirement of the crops in that area, in the field after harvesting against specific perils of hailstorm, cyclone, cyclonic rains and unseasonal...
applies_to: Harvested crops in cut-and-spread / small bundled condition
deadline_or_rate: Up to 2 weeks (14 days) from harvest

rule_text: 5.2.4 Localized Calamities : Loss/damage to notified insured crops resulting from occurrence of identified localized risks of hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloud burst and natural fire due to lightening affecting isolated farms in the notified area.
applies_to: Isolated insured farms in notified area (e.g. hailstorm)
deadline_or_rate: Individual farm-level loss assessment

rule_text: 5.2.5 Add-on coverage for crop loss due to attack by wild animals: The States may consider providing add-on coverage for crop loss due to the attack by wild animals wherever the risk is perceived to be substantial and is identifiable. The detailed protocol and procedure for evaluation of the bids has been prepared by the GOI in consultation with the...
applies_to: Areas where state notifies wild animal attack add-on
deadline_or_rate: Optional farmer add-on cover

rule_text: 5.4 General Exclusions: Losses arising out of war and nuclear risks, malicious damage and other preventable risks shall be excluded.
applies_to: All PMFBY policies
deadline_or_rate: War, nuclear risks, malicious damage, preventable risks excluded

rule_topic: Kharif foodgrain and oilseed premium cap
rule_text: Maximum Premium Rate payable by farmer (% of Sum Insured): Kharif All Food grain and Oilseeds crops (all Cereals, Millets, Pulses and Oilseeds crops) 2.0% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less
applies_to: Kharif cereals, millets, pulses, and oilseeds (e.g. soybean)
deadline_or_rate: 2.0% of Sum Insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less

rule_topic: Rabi foodgrain and oilseed premium cap
rule_text: Maximum Premium Rate payable by farmer (% of Sum Insured): Rabi All Food grain and Oilseeds crops (all Cereals, Millets, Pulses and Oilseeds) 1.5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less
applies_to: Rabi cereals, millets, pulses, and oilseeds (e.g. wheat, gram)
deadline_or_rate: 1.5% of Sum Insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less

rule_text: Maximum Premium Rate payable by farmer (% of Sum Insured): Annual Commercial/ Annual Horticultural crops 5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less Perennial horticultural/commercial crops (pilot basis) 5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less
applies_to: Kharif and Rabi annual commercial/horticultural crops (e.g. cotton)
deadline_or_rate: 5% of Sum Insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less

deadline_or_rate: Within 72 hours of loss occurrence

rule_text: 21.5.4.2 Channel of reporting i.e. Whom to be reported: Intimation may be given within 72 hours by the farmer either directly, the “Crop Insurance App”, dedicated toll-free number, Centralized Call Centre number of concerned Insurance Company. The intimation may also be forwarded through the concerned bank branch, local agriculture department...

rule_topic: Bank and official forwarding timeline (48 hours)
rule_text: 21.5.4.4 In case the intimation has been through the concerned bank branch or Government officials, the concerned IC should be informed within the next 48 hours.
applies_to: Bank branch or district/agriculture officials forwarding intimation

rule_text: 21.5.5.1 Duly filled intimation form along with all relevant documents is necessary for initiation of loss assessment and payment of claims.However, if information on all the columns is not readily available, semi-filled form may be sent to the Insurance Company and later within 7days of the loss, the form with complete details may be submitted.
applies_to: Farmers submitting semi-filled claim intimation form
deadline_or_rate: Complete details within 7 days of loss

rule_topic: Official portal and live claim status scope
rule_text: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Crop Insurance | PMFBY - Crop Insurance - Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is the government sponsored crop insurance scheme that integrates multiple stakeholders on a single platform. Static guidelines explain scheme rules and deadlines; individual farmer claim approval status is not stored here and must be checked on NCIP / pmfby.gov.in.
applies_to: Individual claim status & live season notifications
deadline_or_rate: Check pmfby.gov.in / NCIP or Helpline 14447
